groups.title: hand 扌
groups.note: Three strokes on the left: something done with the hand.

chars.story: A hand held out across the path: block the path.
chars.note: Traditional 攔: the right-hand part was simplified to 兰.

chars.story: A hand flings the cup to the floor: thrown down and broken.
chars.note: Also used when a person falls: 摔了一跤.

chars.story: The hand lets go and the thing is gone: thrown away.
A hand sweeps across the table to its far end: smear.
chars.note: Also counts wisps: 一抹微笑 'a trace of a smile'.

chars.story: The hand joins itself to the thing on the ground: pick it up.
chars.note: Also the formal written 'ten', as on cheques.

groups.title: heart 心 忄
groups.note: A heart below, or three strokes beside: feelings and moods.

chars.story: A heart in no hurry at all: leisurely.
chars.note: 悠久 stretches the idea over time: a long, unhurried history.

chars.story: Stirring up another person's heart: you provoke him.
A heart gone wild: panicky.
chars.note: Also after a verb, 累得慌 'unbearably tired'.

chars.story: A heart kept still so no one hears: quietly.
A heart that will not stir: lazy.
chars.note: Traditional 懶: 赖 simplified the right-hand part.

groups.title: water 氵
groups.note: Three drops on the left: streams, shores, liquids.

chars.story: A thin ribbon of water running through the hills: a brook.

chars.parts: 氵 water + 厓 cliff edge
chars.story: Where the water meets the cliff edge, the world ends: horizon.
chars.note: 生涯 is a whole working life, as a 'career'.

chars.story: Water closes over the boat: it sinks into ruin.
chars.note: Traditional 淪: 仑 simplified the right-hand part.

chars.story: Water takes the sugar in and holds it: it dissolves.

groups.title: person 亻
groups.note: A person standing at the left.

chars.story: A person at your left hand, helping: an aide.
chars.note: 左 sits in it as the helping hand.

chars.story: A person who hands his skill on to you: an instructor.
chars.note: Mostly 师傅, a polite address to a skilled worker or driver. Also the surname Fu.

chars.story: A person who cannot bend or turn: rigid.
chars.note: Traditional 僵 is the same shape.

chars.story: A young girl's skin, soft to touch: tender.
chars.note: Used for young shoots and lightly cooked food too.

chars.story: A woman whose trade is selling company: prostitute.
chars.note: A blunt, old-fashioned word; 艺妓 is the geisha.

chars.story: A woman stands square in the doorway: she hampers the way.
chars.note: Almost always met in 不妨 and 无妨.

chars.story: The woman who comes to live at the family hearth: daughter-in-law.
chars.note: 媳妇 is also a casual word for 'wife'.

groups.title: the body 月
groups.note: The flesh radical 月 marks body parts.

chars.story: The flesh that swings out from the shoulder: the arm.
Flesh in the chest that fills and empties: the lungs.
A rice field inside the body where the food is sown: the stomach.
chars.note: 胃口 also means a person's taste or appetite for something.

groups.title: sun 日
groups.note: The sun on the left or on top.

chars.story: The sun sunk low: twilight.
chars.note: Also 'faint, dim': 昏倒 'fall in a faint'.

chars.story: Sunlight picks out every detail: distinct.
Head spinning under a hot sun: dizzy.
chars.note: Also a halo round the sun or moon. Traditional 暈: 軍 became 军.

groups.title: mouth 口
groups.note: A mouth on the left: calls and cries.

chars.story: A mouth opens in sudden surprise: hey!
chars.note: An interjection, never a content word.

chars.story: A mouth calls the cat to its rice: here, kitty.
chars.note: Only in affectionate words: 猫咪, 妈咪.

groups.title: sickness 疒
groups.note: A sickness frame wrapped round the left and top.

chars.story: A mind sick with its one idea: silly.
chars.note: Also doting: 痴迷 'obsessed'.

chars.story: A sickness in the skin and bones: fatigued.

chars.parts: 广 lean-to + 亻 person + 鸟 bird
chars.story: A bird of prey above the lean-to, watching the person below: an eagle.
chars.note: Traditional 鷹: 鳥 became 鸟.

chars.story: A bird with a plated back, waddling to the pond: a duck.
chars.note: Traditional 鴨: 鳥 became 鸟.

chars.story: A bird with its mouth open: it cries out.
chars.note: Used of birds, insects and bells.

chars.parts: - two wing feathers side by side
chars.story: Two feathers lying side by side: a feather.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'feathers'. Same shape, same sense; modern prose uses it in 羽毛.

groups.title: animals
groups.note: Four creatures of field and hill.

chars.parts: - a crouching hare with long ears and a short tail
chars.story: A hare crouched with ears up and a stub of a tail: a rabbit.

chars.parts: - a shell with a head and legs poking out
chars.story: A shell with a head and four legs poking out: a turtle.
chars.note: Traditional 龜 was far busier; 龟 keeps only the outline.

chars.parts: - antlers on top, a body and legs below
chars.story: Antlers on top, legs below: a deer.
An insect that swarms round the hive: a bee.
A garment that hangs from the waist: a skirt.
Clothes enough to fill a valley: well off.

chars.parts: 衣 clothes wrapped round 中 middle
chars.story: The middle of the garment, next to the heart: inner feelings.
chars.note: 衣 is split in two, with 中 tucked inside.

chars.story: A small metal thing that rings when shaken: a bell.
chars.note: Traditional 鈴: 金 became 钅.

chars.story: The metal bit that sends a horse on its way; the badge that sends a man up in title.
chars.note: Also 'hold in the mouth', as a horse holds its bit. Traditional 銜.

chars.story: A thousand strands of silk, each thin: fine thread.
chars.note: Traditional 纖.

chars.story: Silk thread where two edges meet: a seam.
chars.note: As a verb it means 'sew': 缝合 'sew up'. Traditional 縫.

chars.story: Thread twisted until it is thick: a rope.
chars.note: Traditional 繩.

chars.story: Shells (money) passed across so he will have his way: bribery.
chars.note: 贝 was money in old China. Traditional 賄.

chars.story: Treasure handed down from above: bestowed.
chars.note: Traditional 賜.

chars.story: A cup of wine poured back to the one who treated you: a reward in return.
chars.note: Also pay: 薪酬 'salary'.

chars.story: The part of the tree that splits off: a branch.
Wooden staves bound into a vessel: a bucket.
A length of wood fitted to an axe: a handle.
chars.note: Today mostly a surname, Ke, or part of a loanword like 柯基 'corgi'.

chars.story: A low spiky plant along the ground: caltrop.
chars.note: Seen in transliterated names, as in 盖茨 'Gates'.

chars.story: Grass cleared for a ritual: the Cai family name.
chars.note: Surname Cai, and an ancient state. Cai Lun is credited with inventing paper.

chars.story: A plant whose root is dug out like a catch from a net: radish.
chars.note: Only in words: 萝卜. Traditional 蘿.

chars.story: Grass stacked as winter feed for livestock: stored up.

chars.parts: - a frame with a cross inside, standing for a hill
chars.story: A low frame of hill, crossed by a track: a hill ridge.
chars.note: Traditional 岡 had 山 inside it. Mostly in place names and loanwords.

chars.story: A hill piled on a mountain: a high peak.
chars.note: 岳父 and 岳母 are a wife's parents: the high peaks of the family.

chars.story: Earth heaped in a long dragon's back across the field: a ridge.
chars.note: In 垄断 a trader holds the high ridge alone. Traditional 壟.

chars.story: A bank of earth between a hundred fields: a raised path.
chars.note: In modern writing, almost only 陌生 'unfamiliar'.

groups.title: earth 土
groups.note: Earth on the left or below.

chars.story: Earth piled into a gap: blocked up.
A square of ground in town with its own gate: a lane.
chars.note: In 作坊 it means 'workshop'.

chars.parts: - a drooping stalk standing on 土 earth
chars.story: A stalk bends over, its tip hanging toward the earth: hang down.
A horse bursts through the gate: charge in.
chars.note: Traditional 闖.

chars.story: A heart shut in behind a gate: depressed.
chars.note: Also 'stuffy': 闷热. Traditional 悶.

chars.story: A house with a roof and no voices: solitary and still.

chars.parts: 宀 roof + 日 sun + 女 woman
chars.story: Under one roof, in daylight, women serve a feast: a banquet.
Fire under the pot: boil.

chars.parts: 艹 grass + 丞 (sound) + 灬 fire
chars.story: Damp plants over a fire: steam rises.

chars.parts: 饣 food + 几 small table
chars.story: A small table with no food on it: hungry.
chars.note: Traditional 飢. Literary 'hungry': 饥饿 'hunger', 饥荒 'famine'.

chars.story: A stone dish for holding rice: a bowl.
chars.note: 饭碗 also means a person's livelihood.

chars.story: Walk fast while the chance is still there: take advantage.
Feet folded under you in danger: kneel.
A stone brought down hard: smash.
chars.note: 搞砸 means to make a mess of something.

chars.parts: 臣 bowed servant + 卜 (shortened person)
chars.story: A servant bows lower and lower until he is lying flat.
chars.note: Traditional 臥 had 人 where this has 卜.

chars.story: A wide-open yawn: time to take a break.
chars.note: 歇业 is what a shop does when it closes up.

chars.story: A hand raised in respect to hold a thing high: hold aloft.
chars.note: Almost only in 引擎 'engine', a loanword.

chars.story: An old bitter wrong: a sin.
chars.note: Both words are common: 无辜 is 'without sin'.

chars.story: Kind words that let the fault pass: excuse.
chars.note: Traditional 諒: 言 became 讠.

chars.story: A person inside four walls: a prisoner.
A cloth pulled across the eyes: kept in the dark, concealed.
chars.note: Traditional 瞞.

groups.title: qualities
groups.note: Four ways a person or thing may be.

chars.story: Bamboo with a thick root: heavy, slow and clumsy.

chars.parts: - a child standing straight and still
chars.story: A child stands straight with hands at his sides, as told: well-behaved.
chars.note: The strokes carry no smaller parts.

chars.parts: - a hand holding up a low dish
chars.story: A hand holds the dish up for those above: low rank.
chars.note: Modern prose: 自卑 'feel inferior'.

chars.story: Colour in abundance: glamorous.
chars.note: Traditional 豔.

chars.parts: - a bent stroke like a fish hook
chars.story: A bent hook, the second mark in a list.
chars.note: Like B in A, B, C: second of the ten Heavenly Stems.

chars.parts: 又 right hand + 丶 dot
chars.story: A hand with a prong stuck through it: a fork.
A ladle tipped over: slanting.
A tool as straight as an arrow, big enough to measure with: a carpenter's square.
chars.note: 规矩 is 'rules, proper manners'.

chars.story: A village squeezed under a cliff: a tiny hundredth part.
chars.note: Traditional 釐.

chars.story: A strip of cloth hung up high: a flag.
chars.note: Only in 旗帜. Traditional 幟.

chars.story: A door-shaped panel of feathers: a fan.
chars.note: Also counts doors and windows: 一扇门.

chars.parts: 尸 body + 彳 step + 夂 foot + 舟 boat
chars.story: A body steps on, feet in boat-shaped shoes: tread on.
chars.note: In 履行 you 'tread out' a promise. Also 'shoe'.

chars.parts: 王 jade + 文 pattern + 王 jade
chars.story: Patterns showing through two pieces of jade: spots.
Jade as plentiful as a forest: gems.
chars.note: Mostly in names and in 琳琅满目.

chars.story: A ghost's pull on the living: charm.
chars.note: 魅力 is the common word.

chars.story: The tongue goes over it: lick.
chars.note: The ordinary verb for licking.

chars.story: A heap of words piled up: verbose.
chars.note: Mostly a surname, Zhan, and in 詹姆斯 'James'.

chars.story: A father with many mouths: dad.
chars.note: Colloquial; 爸 is the usual word.

sentences.en: He shot an arrow at the deer.
It is this window that he broke.

sentences.zh: 我用丝线缝了这条裙子。
sentences.en: I sewed the dress with silk thread.

sentences.zh: 生活就像是舔仙人掌上的蜂蜜。
sentences.en: Life is like licking honey off a cactus.

sentences.zh: 他垂下手臂环绕住她然后亲吻。
sentences.en: He slid his arms around her and kissed her.

sentences.zh: 她在树枝上把自己的裙子扯烂了。
sentences.en: She ripped her dress on a branch.

sentences.zh: 如果蜜蜂都偷懒的话，盛开的花便不会结果了。
sentences.en: If the bees do not work, the flowers will not bear fruit.

sentences.zh: 一个入室盗窃者趁我去旅游的时候闯入了我家。
sentences.en: A burglar broke into my house while I was away on a trip.
